stem: After SDF is applied to a child's carious lesions, which follow-up reassessment plan is most consistent with current guidance?

options.text: Plan reassessment and anticipate that SDF may need to be applied again over time to maintain arrest.
Treat the single application as definitive and omit any planned reassessment.
Treat a lesion that has turned black and hard at recall as a treatment failure requiring retreatment.
Keep the discussion of staining brief at consent, since it is a minor point.
